about: gate.selection's recorded cases (MODULAR-GATE-1). Each LANE case is a lane's diff as it merged into d-build (merge^1..merge) or as its own scoped gate ran, the suites its gates found RED with a verdict of REAL (must: the selector must include every one — a miss is a selector defect, fixed in scripts/gate-scope.py and never by editing this list), the reds judged ENVIRONMENTAL (env: reported, not required — contention, a GPU-time bar under load, a persistent home), and the lane's own named suites. The evidence for every verdict is the lane's spike (named per case) and the ledger entry. A FILES case is the suites audit's S1/S2 (SPECS/audits/GATE_SUITES_AUDIT_2026-09-26.md §7): a subject path must select its suites. When a suite is renamed or becomes a pool's arm, rename it here in the same commit. TEST-CUT-1 (2026-10-20) took every row outside THE SHIP SET out of the tree (archive/tests/ in the lead repo): an archived row is dropped from the cases like a deleted one, a recorded path the cut archived is listed in its case's `archived_paths` and not replayed (its owner is gone: replayed, it would fall to its directory), and a HUNK case whose text the cut archived is retired (archive/tests/gate/gate_selection_cases.retired.json). THE TWO KEYS, ONE LINE EACH (TOOLING-7): `archived_paths` — the case's recorded paths whose owner TEST-CUT-1 archived, never replayed (replayed they would fall to their directory and select nothing of the law they recorded); `rows_at_tip_only` — a replay whose range REGISTERS rows this build does not have (archived, or new at the range's tip): their registration commands resolve to nothing here and fall to their test directory, which gate.selection accepts as no whole-tier fallback but asserts touches tests/ only.
